assets.title: BodyParts3D head/dental anatomy reference
assets.attribution: BodyParts3D / Anatomography, © The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS). Adapted by OrganUI.
assets.modifications: OrganUI selected 33 BodyParts3D meshes, triangulated polygon faces, recentered and uniformly scaled coordinates, changed axes to [x, z, -y], recomputed smooth normals, assigned illustrative colors and converted OBJ to GLB. procad redistributes the pinned model unchanged.

units.note: GLB coordinates are display-normalized, not millimetres. Pinned preparation scales source by 0.025 and maps axes [x,y,z] to [x,z,-y]. Pinned original incisor OBJ header declares Bounds(mm); its hash was verified. x40 recovers upstream-declared source scale, not patient-specific calibration or independent physical measurement. No mm placement or measurement is enabled.

assets.notes: 28 permanent teeth, no primary teeth or third molars. Anatomy atlas, never a crown morphology, implant or scan-body library. Viewer does not export clinical geometry. This subset does not cover the rest of the body.
